name: Maya, the busy operations manager
summary: PLACEHOLDER persona until our research-based personas are ready. A time-pressed, non-technical professional who uses the product a few times a week to get one specific job done and wants to get back to their day.
role: Operations manager at a mid-sized company (about 200 employees)
goals: Finish the task quickly and correctly, without needing to contact support
Feel confident the action actually worked (clear confirmation)
Avoid making mistakes that would need explaining to their manager
frustrations: Jargon and internal product terminology they don't recognise
Having to hunt through menus for things that should be obvious
Unexpected extra steps, pop-ups or forced sign-ups
Unclear error messages that don't say how to fix the problem
behaviors: Scans pages rather than reading them; relies on headings, button labels and search
Usually tries the most obvious-looking link or button first
Rarely reads help documentation unless completely stuck
Often multitasking and interrupted, so prefers short flows
Will use the browser back button when lost
domainKnowledge: Understands the business problem the product solves, but has no knowledge of how the product is organised internally or what its features are called.
